notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello, Gamers!

Welcome to the next Devlog. Everyone knows that having the right people besides you is key to success. This sentence is also true when we’re talking about our game. Without a proper team, you have less chance to triumph. So how should you choose the right people? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/7a2b910d4c33b15ac009e755edfaba0c2fb73cca.png[/img]

You have two types of them:
[list]
[*] Required for example car thieves.
[*] Optional for example a mechanic who will help you with work on cars.
[/list]

To every single person, you have a trust rate that affects price, the scope of work, entrance to assign localization with better vehicles, and better-paid missions for cars which they steal on their own. 
Everyone in the team has their statistics and perks:
(statistics)
[olist]
[*] Discretion: the chance of being detected during stealing and the chance to be tracked to a chop shop. 
[*] Breaking security: how fast someone can defeat security at the scene of the action (e.g. working out patrols, disabling cameras).
[*] Breaking-in: how fast someone can break into a car without being noticed.
[/olist]
(perks)
[list]
[*] Guide: he/she can choose the most optimal escape route.
[*] Silver-tongued: he/she can chat with the police to buy some time.
[*] Assiduousness: the chance of finding additional hiding security. 
[*] Diligence: how many things from the checklist can be done from your duties if you paid him/her.
[*] Perfectionist: Do everything from a checklist.
[/list]

You have a limit of how many people you hire at the same time. That’s why you have to sometimes dismiss someone to employ someone else.

If you want to hire somebody you need to contact them by phone. 

We hope that you like today’s devlog. Next time we will say something about how to earn money in Chop Shop Simulator so stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Today’s devlog will be about earning money in Chop Shop Simulator. So let’s start!

Your potential client may not like to know that his/her new car is a stolen vehicle. That’s why you need to hide this for example by:

[list]
[*] Changing number plate.
[*] Finding and moving out GPSs 
[*] Repainting car.
[*] Changing parts that are broken after breaking into it.
[*] Polishing serial numbers.
[*] Buying a broken/burned car and swapping VIN.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/bff048c4939b052fd1cd5ac9fe493f3f5bcff558.gif[/img]

You can sell all cars on auction or by parts. It’s your choice but remember that if you don’t do everything to legalize, the police can find you. 

Starting price can affect how fast you will sell your car but it also can interest the police. 

Your potential client can bargain with you so prepare yourself for that and remember that if you wait for the best offer too long you can lose out on it.

Hope you liked today’s devlog. If you want to know more or you have any question join our Discord (https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw)

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

We are very pleased to meet you. We are the team responsible for the communication of the Chop Shop Simulator project. We want to bring you closer to the content related to our game. We hope to diversify your waiting time for the premiere with our posts. 

As you may know, in this game you have to steal cars. You might wonder how to do it so here is the answer. 

1. Plan

You can ride around the town and choose what car you want to steal. Spot by your phone security and danger like cameras, nearest police station, security guards etc. The more you spot, the easier your job will be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/d283f0e311fae08a8e2407a5664d93b66b92352c.png[/img]

Decide what kind of people do you need and what kind of action would be (laud - you have more chance to end with success but it’s more possible that police will interest in it and it’s much expensive; or quiet - cheaper, police probably won’t interest this case but you have less chance to end with success).

Plan exactly how to steal, how to escape etc. 

2. Hire the right people to your job (We will talk more about this in the next devlog).

3. Steal and make cash on it (How? You will know it soon ;) )

We hope that you like this short devlog. If you have any questions write comment or join our Discord (https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw)
